author: Harford News
title: Bel Air Recreation Committee announces final call for junior wrestling registration
text:
Bel Air Recreation Committee announces final call for junior wrestling registration
The Bel Air Recreation Committee has issued a final call for junior wrestling registration, with the deadline set for November 5. The program offers multiple teams for various ages and experience levels, with practices beginning in mid-November at local schools. Wrestlers must be at least five years old by November 15 to participate.
Bel Air Recreation Committee has announced that registration for the Bel Air Junior Wrestling program will close on November 5. The program offers several teams based on age, experience, and skill level, with practices set to begin in mid-November at Patterson Mill High School and Bel Air High School.
The Novice Elementary team, intended for first- and second-year wrestlers, will start on November 16. Practices for this group will be held twice a week on Mondays and Wednesdays at Patterson Mill High School. The committee said, "Our Novice elementary team is for first- and second-year wrestlers. The wrestling room will be split by age and weight to make sure there are partners for all our wrestlers. Our Novice elementary team practices 2x per week on Mondays and Wednesdays at Patterson Mill HS. If your wrestler is Novice, but in Middle School, they will automatically be placed into Room 3."
For those with one to two or more years of experience, or novice wrestlers with a certain skill set, the Novice/Competitive Elementary team will begin on November 17. This group will practice on Tuesdays and Thursdays at Patterson Mill High School. The committee said, "Our Novice/ Competitive Elementary team is for wrestlers with 1-2 or more years of experience or wrestlers in their first and second year with a certain skill set. The wrestling room will be split by weight and skill level to ensure there are partners for all our wrestlers. Our Novice/ Competitive Elementary team practices 2x per week on Tuesdays and Thursdays at Patterson Mill HS."
The Competitive Elementary/Middle team, which includes wrestlers with three or more years of experience or middle school students with less experience, will also start on November 17. Practices for this group will be held three times a week on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays at Bel Air High School. Novice wrestlers will have the option to practice on Wednesdays as well. The committee said, "Our Novice/ Competitive Elementary/ middle team is for wrestlers with 3 or more years of experience and/ or they are 0-2 year wrestlers in Middle School. The wrestling room will be split by weight and skill level to ensure there are partners for all our wrestlers. Our Competitive team practices 3x per week on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays at Bel Air HS. Novice will have the option to practice on Wednesdays as well."
Competitive wrestlers are encouraged, but not required, to attend additional practices on Wednesdays at Bel Air High School in Room 3. Coaches will work to match partners of similar skill levels to provide more opportunities for mat time. The committee said, "Competitive wrestlers are encouraged, but not required, to attend additional practices on Wednesdays at BAHS in Room 3. Coaches will work to match partners of similar skill levels to provide additional opportunities for wrestlers who are seeking more mat time."
Wrestlers must be at least five years old by November 15, 2026, to register. Bel Air High School, which will host some of the practices, had an enrollment of 1,946 students in the 2020-2021 school year and serves grades 9 to 12, according to the Texas Education Agency.
